Description: REGISTERED BUT DELIBERATELY NOT EXTRACTED - FAILS GEOGRAPHIC ARITHMETIC. Table 3 reports Lake Tana Basin cholera as 'Aug-Sep 2006: 13386, CFR = 1.6', 'June-Sep 2016: 3565; CFR = 0.8', 'Jun-Aug 2017: 3207'. The 2006 figure cannot stand: WHO Disease Outbreak News of 4 Oct 2006 (metadata Index 46) puts the ENTIRE Ethiopian AWD epidemic at 22,101 cases to 28 Sep 2006 and states Oromiya alone accounted for 79 percent of them (approx 17,460), leaving at most about 4,600 for every other region combined - so 13,386 in the Amhara Lake Tana Basin over Aug-Sep 2006 would make the parts exceed the whole. The paper is also internally inconsistent on 3207, stating in the body that 'A four-year data analysis showed that 3207 cholera cases were recorded in 2014, 2016 and 2017' (a three-year total) while Table 3 assigns the same 3207 to Jun-Aug 2017 alone; and 3565 for 2016 alone would then exceed that three-year total. Because one Table 3 row demonstrably fails an arithmetic check, none of the three were extracted. The Lake Tana Basin is also a hydrological area spanning 61 districts across several Amhara zones, not an administrative unit. Left for Agent 5 to adjudicate against the primary references (refs 40-43) if it can obtain them.
